proof_status: exact reproduction; independent mathematical review pending
infinite_lattice_extension: Positive weights remove loops. Every alternative simple path has at least four edges, hence cost >=4; either two-edge path has cost <=4. Finite-box Dijkstra is an independent computational cross-check, while this argument supplies the infinite-lattice extension.
forcing_scope: Forcing the tested edge to 1 gives a two-edge route of cost at most 3. All other simple paths cost at least 4. Hence all forced-low minimizing paths are among the two checked routes, also on the full lattice.
